notes.title: The Survival Patch
notes.content:
The Survival Patch (2.5.3)

Sorry Steam players for no updates! But get ready for this one.

The following patch notes are a compilation from versions 2.5.1 and 2.5.2 and 2.5.3!



 HORROR IS BACK IN FOREST AS SURVIVAL! A NEW GAMEMODE! (Horror as a map is still there!)
 Added animations to Jansell (Shop Keeper)
 Friends List now only shows 5 friends per page for readability
 Spring is here and the snow has melted… The maps are back to its beautiful greenery!
 Added Main Menu
 Added Emoticons
 Added Community Voting (We will arrange voting topics)
 Added Silver Tier Mod Menu now for sale in Mall for $11.99
 Added 4 New Cosmetics (Mohawk, Pirate, Jumpsuit, JetPack)
 Mod Menus now become discounted by 20% when you own one (1) or more
 Color is now randomized for new players (No longer 0, 0, 0)
 Improved Anticheat (All modded APKs are invalid)
 Randomize Cosmetics button added to Lockers
 Invisible colliders in Horror fixed
 Fixed Log system so its actually readable and doesn’t just spam stuff
 Music on Speakers now play when you load in and aren’t muted by default


JOIN THE DISCORD FOR MORE INFORMATION ON THE GAME AND TO CHAT!
Discord: https://discord.gg/AhNp6vPmrv

notes.title: Monkey Mischief on Steam is going free to play!
notes.content:
MONKEY MISCHIEF ON STEAM IS GOING FREE TO PLAY

After much consideration by the team, it was decided that we needed to make Monkey Mischief on Steam free to play.

When the game launched on Steam, we expected hackers, or skids, but nothing happened.
The 4.99 price was simply there to combat hackers, but there were no hackers.

Making Monkey Mischief free also means we can target a much wider audience, and provide this incredible game for more people, free of charge.

There is not a current date on when it is going free to play, but it will happen in time with the next patch.


When Monkey Mischief goes free to play on Steam, you will no longer receive 15,000 Nanas with your purchase of the game.
